dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: Hey Mira, when talking about "sex" in English, what do you understand it as? I mean the action or giới tính?

dialogue.text: I'm sorry if I made you uncomfortable. But sometimes the word "sex" causes misunderstandings in Vietnamese. I just wanted to hiểu clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You always have such a clever way of explaining things. But if you want to talk about gender, why not use the word "gender" to be clear? Or... are you deliberately trying to make me embarrassed?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: That's not it. I just find it interesting to discuss cultural differences. But I thích the way you blush when talking about this topic. It's very... cute.
